text: New API Provider 是面向 DSH 网页端的模型网关插件，可把一个或多个 New API 渠道接入 DSH 的模型路由，并在渠道间切换当前服务来源。它读取网关模型目录，展示上下文与模态等能力信息，允许按模型调整名称、协议和参数，并提供渠道管理、额度查看、图像生成及实验性视频生成工具。适合通过 New API 或兼容网关使用多种模型、管理多个服务端点的 DSH 用户。配置网关地址并在 DSH credential 服务中提供对应 token；模型能力补充可选用 models.dev。

New API Provider connects New API gateways to DSH's web model route. It lists models, shows capability details, supports per-model overrides, and offers channel, quota, image, and experimental video tools. Provide a gateway URL and token through DSH credentials.

How can I switch between several model gateway accounts in DSH?
New API Provider 的功能「多渠道模型接入」：把多个 New API 网关保存为独立渠道，并将激活渠道接入 DSH 模型路由。用户可为各渠道维护模型列表与覆盖设置，再选择当前使用的渠道。
New API Provider 的功能「模型目录与参数覆盖」：读取指定渠道的模型，并返回种类、上下文窗口、输出上限、模态和推理能力等信息；用户可按模型设置本地名称、上游模型名及其他能力覆盖。
New API Provider 的功能「额度和媒体生成」：提供查询当前渠道 token 用量的工具，并注册图像生成、图像编辑及视频任务提交和状态查询工具；生成的媒体可保存为 DSH 附件。

dsh-newapi-provider README · Install：Requires **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or newer** (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) and Node.js 22.19+.

Install `dsh-newapi-provider` with DSH's plugin manager, then refresh the page and open **Settings → New API Provider**. No separate web server is needed.

1. **Add gateway** — name, New API site URL, calling token.
2. **Fetch models** — read what the gateway lists, select the ones you want.
3. **Activate the gateway** — this plugin's model route now serves those models.
dsh-newapi-provider README · Install：The token is stored in the DSH credential service, never in the gateway configuration, and is never sent back to the browser.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Features：- Several gateways, exactly one active; each keeps its own URL, credential reference, model list and model overrides.
- Channel-scoped model management: fetch what a gateway lists, choose which models appear in DSH, test one model, remove with undo, add models the gateway does not list.
- Capability data from models.dev (context window, output cap, modalities, reasoning), correctable per model, with an optional per-model upstream name mapping.
- Token quota in the settings summary and at the sidebar foot, plus the account balance when the token is allowed to query it.
- Image generation saved as durable DSH attachments with a generation history; experimental video through the unified `/v1/videos` interface with background polling and restart recovery.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Gateways and quota：1. **Test connection** reads the model list only and does not make paid model calls; it also shows the gateway version and model counts.
2. **Activate** switches every subsequent call made through this plugin, or tick "activate after saving".
3. Switching never rewrites other adapters or your default provider.
4. Submitted video tasks keep their originating gateway and are never polled on a newly activated one.

Quota details:

dsh-newapi-provider README · Gateways and quota：- Quota comes from `GET /api/usage/token/` (note the trailing slash).
- Amounts are converted with `/api/status` (`quota_per_unit`, `quota_display_type`, `usd_exchange_rate`), never the top-up price.
- A token that allows user-quota queries also reports the account balance.
- An unlimited token shows used quota instead of a meaningless negative remainder.
- Both numbers are the site's own; a present catalog or balance does not prove an upstream channel can serve a model.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Gateways and quota：The sidebar shows the active gateway's name and amount, with a health dot; click it to refresh. It collapses to a status dot when the sidebar is a rail.
dsh-newapi-provider README · Per-gateway model lists：Each gateway keeps an independent list, even when two gateways point at the same site with the same token:

dsh-newapi-provider README · Per-gateway model lists：- **Model capabilities tab** has a gateway picker; the active gateway is marked and its list edits apply to that gateway only.
- **Fetch models** reads the gateway catalog with a search box plus status (new / added / removed upstream) and kind filters, grouped by kind; filtering only changes what is listed, never the current selection. The list scrolls on its own and the action bar stays in view.
- **Remove** only removes the model from this gateway; custom parameters can be kept and the removal can be undone briefly.
- **Add manually** is for models the gateway can serve but does not list.
- Gateways created in current versions start with an empty list; channels saved before the feature existed stay in automatic mode (all gateway models) until their first edit, which materialises the list from what the gateway currently lists.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Testing models：- **Chat models**: one minimal streaming request. The result remembers success, total latency, first packet time and a redacted error. A stream that only sends `[DONE]` counts as a failure, because it carries no protocol response.
- **Image/video models**: a real generation, so each test asks for confirmation first. Image tests show a preview when the URL is safe to embed; a signed URL is recorded as generated without exposing it.
- **Batch test** covers the chat models currently filtered, three at a time. Stopping prevents queued requests; requests already sent still finish and may be billed.
- Tests are billed requests: chat tests send a tiny completion, image/video tests generate.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Model names and mapping：- **Local model id**: the stable id used by sessions and the model list; never changed by the editor.
- **Display name** (`name`): label only.
- **Upstream model name** (`upstreamModel`): the `model` actually sent. Empty means the local id. Mapping is one hop and applies to chat, image generation, image edits, video and model tests.
- The editor previews the mapping, resolves automatic protocol/capabilities/pricing from the mapping target, and lets input modalities and reasoning follow the catalog or be pinned. Reset clears every override including the mapping.
dsh-newapi-provider README · Model names and mapping：Capability data is a hint, not proof: a relay may list a model and still fail to serve it.
dsh-newapi-provider README · Thinking levels：Vendors do not agree on reasoning levels, so each model resolves its own set instead of every reasoning model showing the same five:

dsh-newapi-provider README · Thinking levels：| Vendor / model | Levels offered | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude adaptive thinking (Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable) | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | no `minimal`, no `off` |
| Older Claude (budget based) | off / minimal / low / medium / high | mapped to token budgets |
| GPT-5.1+ / GPT-6 | off / low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `off` is sent as `none`, no `minimal` |
| GPT-5.0 / o-series | minimal / low / medium / high | GPT-5.0 cannot be turned off; o-series stops at high |
| gpt-5-pro | high only | the vendor accepts nothing else |
| Gemini 3 / 4 | minimal / low / medium / high | `thinking_level` has no off; no xhigh/max |
| Gemini 2.5 | off / minimal / low / medium / high | budget based; Pro cannot really be switched off |
| DeepSeek V4 | off / low / high / max | the vendor folds the in-between levels |
| GLM-5.3 | low / high / max | sending `disabled` errors, so no off |
| GLM-5.2 | all seven | most levels are folded upstream |
| Kimi K3 | low / high / max | no medium, cannot be switched off |
| Qwen3 / unknown | off / minimal / low / medium / high | pi-ai's own default when a model has no levels |
dsh-newapi-provider README · Thinking levels：Resolution order: **your override → pi-ai's shipped model data (same model, same behaviour as the built-in provider) → vendor-family default**.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Thinking levels：**Model capabilities → Edit model → Thinking levels** opens on a table pre-filled from the model data (turn the switch off to see the detected set read-only). The left column is the level shown in the chat selector — the built-ins (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) or a name you type yourself (1–24 lowercase letters, digits, `-`, `_`); a custom level must carry a value and then appears in the chat selector like any other. The right column is what that level sends upstream; an empty value sends nothing. The mapping is stored per model per gateway and affects only this plugin.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Thinking levels：> Limitation: relays rename models (`claude-opus-5-5`), so a family guess fills the gap when the exact id is unknown. Use a custom override if the upstream disagrees. A level only changes the request; whether the upstream honours that depth is up to it.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Models and modalities：models.dev data is cached. Exact matches win; when nothing matches, defaults apply. Base-model matches, defaults and manual overrides are all marked in the UI. Never treat a guessed capability as something the gateway has proven.

The DSH chat interface currently accepts text and image input only. PDF, audio and video tags are catalog metadata and cannot be sent to a DSH chat. Image and video models serve the generation tools and do not appear as chat models.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `newapi_balance` | Quota of the active gateway's token (and account, when allowed). Free. |
| `newapi_models` | Models of a gateway (`channelId` optional, defaults to active) with kind, limits, modalities, pricing, mapping. Free. |
| `newapi_channels` | `list`, `test`, `save`, `activate`, `delete`, `model_override`, `models_discover`, `models_set`, `model_test`. Writes need a revision. |
| `newapi_image_generate` | Text-to-image, or image editing when `inputImages` is given. Saves attachments. |
| `newapi_video_generate` | Submits a video task and returns its id. Billed per task. |
| `newapi_video_status` | Lists or checks video tasks and returns the saved file. |

dsh-newapi-provider README · Tools：Settings-page actions and these tools share one service, so nothing can drift between the UI and the agent.

**Image and video generation cost money.** A submission whose outcome is unknown is never resent automatically; check the gateway's task log first. Stopping a local watch does not cancel or refund the upstream task.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Paid results：- A video submission that loses the connection or returns an unreadable body after HTTP 200 is reported as **submission unknown, possibly billed**, and is never resent automatically.
- A video that finished upstream but failed to download stays **generated, retrying download**. Only GET requests are retried, against refreshed URLs; when the recovery deadline passes it becomes **generated, download unsuccessful**. Do not regenerate.
- Concurrent status checks of one task share a single flow, and unloading the plugin aborts in-flight requests so a stale instance cannot overwrite the new cache.
- Failed paid requests are never retried automatically.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Verification status：- Real chat, model discovery, quota, per-gateway lists and gateway editing have been exercised against a local New API instance (v1.0.0-rc.45).
- A real image request was rejected with HTTP 503 (no available upstream channel). Successful paid image generation is therefore **not yet verified**; the attachment pipeline is covered by offline tests.
- Video is **experimental**: no real video channel was available. Submission, polling, download recovery, restart recovery and duplicate-submission prevention are covered offline only.
- Only one New API deployment has been tested. Other versions and relays may differ in endpoint details.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Migrating from the former name (v0.7.0)：The plugin was called `dsh-newapi-studio`. The rename covers the package, the loader row and provider route (`newapi-provider`), the HTTP prefix (`/newapi-provider/api/`) and the data directory (`plugin-data/dsh-newapi-provider`).

dsh-newapi-provider README · Migrating from the former name (v0.7.0)：To migrate an existing installation, back up the profile patch and plugin data, then keep each channel's id, credential reference, model list and overrides while moving the data directory to the new name. Current releases do not read the old directory automatically. Keep existing credential references even if they contain `STUDIO`: they still hold the working tokens; new references use the `NEWAPI_PROVIDER_` prefix.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Migrating from the former name (v0.7.0)：Sessions pinned to the old `newapi-studio` route must pick models again under the new route. Other adapters are unaffected. Tool names (`newapi_channels`, `newapi_models`, …) did not change.

npm test
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts

To work on a checkout instead of the published package, install the project directory with DSH's plugin manager.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Development：DSH runtime imports are optional peerDependencies supplied by the host, so no DSH package is installed or copied here. Tests use local fake gateways and never read personal credentials. This repository replaces, rather than depends on, `dsh-gateway-provider`; two adapters cannot own the same provider route.

Release steps are in [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md).

MIT License. Uses public DSH exports and pi-ai protocol implementations; no third-party plugin source is vendored.

dsh-newapi-provider README · Development：Vendor marks in the model list come from [LobeHub Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) (`@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.97.0, MIT License), inlined as SVG so the page makes no remote image requests. Brand marks belong to their respective owners and only identify a model's vendor.
